response.overview: Dir EN GREY has been activated on the theme of "pain" from the time of the establishment, and the ninth work of December 2014. The "Average Sorrow" collection of music clips that were created by directors of the demonius, was released on April 1, 2015. As a work published after the previous series "AVERAGE BLASPHEMY", we include 9 pieces including "DIFFERENT SENSE", "Unraveling", "Revelation of mankind", "Keita Kurosaka", "Contour", and "DIR EN GREY" by Yoshi Yamaguchi. The extreme expression and interpretation of the content, which is subjected to a society reality that everyone will want to be noticed by the observer, and has been created to create a dark piece that appeals directly to the sensibility. The clip is newly made from the album "ARCHE", and all of them can be viewed in a full scale song.
response.title: DIR EN GREY - AVERAGE SORROW
